Chapter 866: Chapter 10 Accidental Encounter (Please Subscribe)

Outside the mega battlefield.

One by one, the twelfth-layer ultimate beings are also paying attention to every little thing that happens on the battlefield.

“Hahaha, the first powerhouse to reach the core area battlefield is from our Tianyu Clan!”

“Being the first to arrive doesn’t mean having the advantage.”

“The core area battlefield is vast, there is no significant difference between the first arrival and the last.”

The many twelfth-layer ultimate beings discussed and talked among themselves.

The core area battlefield is the true stage of this mega battlefield, and only the eleventh-layer powerhouses who enter the core area battlefield are genuinely participating in the clash of cosmic pinnacle ethnic power.

“Hmm? The Galaxy Master from the Human Civilization Alliance?”

“He didn’t enter the space-time passage but sat down there instead?”

“No, how is the Galaxy Master this powerful?”

As Lin Yuan began to slaughter many alien eleventh-layers, the expressions of the twelfth-layer ultimate beings gradually changed.

It’s not that the eleventh-layers of various races killed by Lin Yuan were that important but the newly advanced eleventh-layer Galaxy Master having such power?

“You humans, the price you paid to nurture this Galaxy Master was not small.”

“It must have consumed quite a bit of the origin of the ‘Void Realm World,’ right? Otherwise, how could the Galaxy Master have such a high understanding of space-time within such a short time?”

“Hmph, the replication of space-time origin fluctuations by the Void Realm World is after all different from the natural space-time origin fluctuations formed by the universe. Aren’t you afraid that such forced growth will lead to an unstable foundation?”

The various twelfth-layer ultimate beings sneered repeatedly, the whole mega battlefield is essentially a colossal twelfth-layer weapon, capable of blocking the senses of supreme beings.

After all, at the level of life of supreme beings, even just a hint of malice or killing intent could affect the eleventh-layer powerhouses.

To ensure relative fairness in the mega battlefield, supreme beings cannot directly project their senses into the battlefield.

But even without probing with their senses, just by watching from a distance, the twelfth-layer ultimates could somewhat gauge the level of the Galaxy Master’s space-time comprehension.

All the major pinnacle ethnic forces had carefully collected much information about the Galaxy Master.

Stepping into the eleventh-layer did not take much time, yet he possessed such terrifying space-time comprehension, there can only be one explanation.

That is, the Human Civilization Alliance specially created an ‘Outer Realm’ for the Galaxy Master, replicated the cosmic starry skies’ laws with the ‘Void Realm World,’ and then slowed down the flow of time, allowing the Galaxy Master to spend long years in that ‘Outer Realm.’

“Is that so?”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being snorted coldly, and secretly transmitted to the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being: “Yudie, did you really do this?”

“Experiencing the fluctuations of space-time is best done comprehensively within the universe. Using the Void Realm World’s replication, for a genius like the Galaxy Master, might be a bit counterproductive.”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being also felt that this was somewhat inappropriate.

With the talents and capabilities displayed by Lin Yuan, there was no need to rush like this.

“I have never used the Void Realm World for the Galaxy Master,” Feather Butterfly Supreme Being immediately denied through transmission: “The Void Realm World is a Clan Suppression Weapon, although I refine and keep it, every usage is known to you all, right?”

“Not used it?”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being and the other few supreme beings looked at each other.

Without using the Void Realm World to replicate and comprehend space-time origin, how was the Galaxy Master able to achieve such a level of space-time comprehension?

….

Virtual World.

Personal space.

Lin Yuan sat in an armchair, savoring the fine wine in front of him.

In between training, Lin Yuan often came to the Virtual World to relax.

With Lin Yuan’s vast mental will, it was altogether too simple for him to multitask millions of tasks, dedicating a sliver of his mental will to enjoy the Virtual World.

“Abnormal, too abnormal.”

Opposite, Nalan, the deputy tower master, couldn’t help but show a color of amazement.

The numerous information from the mega battlefield were constantly communicated among the many eleventh-layer powerhouses; Lin Yuan’s slaughters, including the Prison Tribe Mingche and massive rock life forms.

As his original body was still alive, naturally, there was no need to particularly hide his encounters.

Especially the Prison Tribe Mingche, in order to make losing a supreme weapon somewhat more reasonable, not only did he not belittle the Galaxy Master, but he even greatly exaggerated him.

Because the Galaxy Master is strong enough, losing a supreme weapon seems somewhat reasonable.

“Did you enter the core area battlefield?”

Lin Yuan asked casually.

“I was lucky, the fringe area I descended in had more than thirty eleventh-layer powerhouses from the Human Civilization Alliance,” Nalan, the deputy tower master, said.

The thirty-plus eleventh-layer powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance, united together, could completely monopolize some of the quotas of the Space-Time Path.

All the eleventh-layer powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance in that area could safely enter the core area battlefield.

That is the advantage of unity.

In fact, the area where Lin Yuan was located, including the massive rock life forms and several dozen special beings, also planned to do the same, even temporarily repelling the Prison Tribe Mingche who wielded a supreme weapon.

But unfortunately.

They encountered Lin Yuan.

The numerical advantage can indeed offer significant benefits at times.

Like the Sea of Bugs Tactics of the Insect Race is based on this principle.

But when the disparity in strength is too great, the advantage of numbers is not that significant.

“That’s good.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

“By the way.”

“I heard something.”

Nalan seemed to think of something, whispering: “The Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and other strongest from the eleventh layer, plan to join forces to besiege you…”

The combat power displayed by Lin Yuan made the eleventh layers from the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and others feel like thorns in their side, hence the idea of besieging him emerged.

“Besiege me?”

Lin Yuan immediately became interested.

This was exactly what he desired.

During the slaughter of the massive rock lifeforms and the Prison Tribe Mingche from other alien eleventh layers, Lin Yuan had intentionally suppressed his own power, all for this moment.

If at that time, Lin Yuan had overwhelmed all the eleventh layers from different races, even Mingche with the Supreme Being weapon couldn’t last a few breaths.

How could the strongest eleventh layers from the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan muster the courage to besiege him?

They wouldn’t even have time to run.

“Yes.”

“You must be careful.”

Nalan spoke earnestly.

Even knowing the formidable combat achievements displayed by Lin Yuan, facing the strongest eleventh layers from all the major peak clans, Nalan still hoped that Lin Yuan would be as cautious as possible.

Those strongest eleventh layers not only relied on themselves but were likely carrying backups from their ultimate beings, with Tianyu Meng from the Tianyu Clan even bringing the Clan Suppression Weapon into the fray.

Clan Suppression Weapons… The might of Clan Suppression Weapons surpassed that of Supreme Being weapons, a major peak clan group that for billions of years, has collected and forged Supreme Being weapons possibly reaching dozens or even hundreds.

For instance, the aurora from outside the universe a few hundred years ago was the main material for forging Supreme Being weapons; a complete aurora from outside the universe could probably forge seven or eight Supreme Being weapons.

But Clan Suppression Weapons? Even if one acquired that once-in-a-universe opportunity, the Human Civilization Alliance could call no more than ten items Clan Suppression Weapons.

Other peak clan forces would have even fewer.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Although Lin Yuan was very confident, he was no fool and knew the terror of the Clan Suppression Weapon.

…

Mega-scale battlefield.

Core area battlefield.

Arriving here through the Space-Time Path, Lin Yuan observed.

“Space-time suppression has surged significantly once again.”

Lin Yuan looked around, the boundless world unfolding before him.

“With my current space-time comprehension, the maximum distance of transposition could reach several light-years, but it consumes a great deal.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Moving several light-years in one step was considered very slow, but this was a mega-scale battlefield meticulously crafted by Supreme Beings, under the space-time suppression, even those eleventh layers could only travel by flying.

Although Lin Yuan could continue Spatial Transposition, his own consumption began to increase significantly.

Sixth Realm space-time comprehension could forcibly manipulate the Space Rules on the mega-scale battlefield, but Lin Yuan, not being a Supreme Being, lacked the Ancestral Force necessary for manipulation.

“I might as well fly slowly.”

Lin Yuan ceased his idea of continuing to advance by transposition.

There’s no need for excessive consumption on this.

Once he encountered the enemy, it would be more cost-effective to perform spatial travel and pursue.

…

“Currently, the position selected by the eleventh layer powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance to establish the war base is in that direction.”

As the supreme commander of the Human Civilization Alliance on this battlefield, Lin Yuan knew many top-secret pieces of intelligence, including the location of the war base.

The war base, a stronghold established by a major peak clan group in this battlefield.

The war base was not only crucial for this war but also served as a foundation for expanding in subsequent wars.

“Head to the war base first.” Lin Yuan changed direction and flew towards a certain location.

…

Time passed.

In a matter of days.

Lin Yuan flew swiftly, his vast sensory range spreading out millions and tens of millions of miles from himself as the center.

In the mega-scale battlefield with heavy space-time suppression, not only was spatial transposition restricted, but even the range of his sensory perception was severely limited.

In the Cosmic Starry Skies, Lin Yuan’s perception could cover hundreds of light-years instantly, but in this mega-scale battlefield? It could only cover millions of miles incrementally.

“Hm? Is there a skirmish occurring tens of millions of miles away?”

Lin Yuan seemed to sense something, his gaze turning towards the right front.

Though vast, the core area battlefield occasionally witnessed encounters between powerhouses from different clans.

Once these powerhouses met, if their respective clans were hostile, a clash was inevitable.

“Let’s go have a look.”

Stirred by curiosity, Lin Yuan headed towards the source of the skirmish.

Soon.

Lin Yuan clearly sensed the parties involved in the skirmish.

“Nine eleventh layers, five against four?”

Lin Yuan suddenly raised an eyebrow: “And there’s a familiar face?”
